description: Execute a chain of aliases against the running game. SILENT FAILURES: an unknown alias name or invalid args fails that step with no thrown error. Returns the standard envelope: the state diff captured before execution, or after the nap when `nap` is given.

def.description: Alias chain definition. Space(' ') for alias(with arg) separator, slash('/') for alias_name-arg separator or arg-arg separator, quote('"') quotes multi-word arg preventing space inside to be parsed as alias(with arg) separator: e.g. `say/"hello world"`. Semicolon for alias's (the alias named as `alias`) extra separator: e.g. `alias/turnDown;setPitch/90`, `alias/turnRight;yaw/90`

nap.description: Optional (1-1200). Defer the tool call's response by N client_tick: the action runs immediately, but the envelope is captured only after N client_tick have elapsed. The game keeps running the whole time — you cannot react to anything or poll state until the call returns. N >= 10 fast-forwards a singleplayer world (~20 tps) for the nap.

verbose.description: Optional (default false). When true, the envelope's state is the FULL snapshot instead of the diff.

name: runAlias
